requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/capitalize.js` and your own tests in `tests/capitalize.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `capitalizeWords(text)`: uppercase the first letter of every space-separated word, lowercase the rest, keep single spacing between words, trim the ends. Non-string input throws TypeError.
